parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true`: `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. The two methods are test-local mock implementations of different resolver operations (`resolveRelease` vs `resolveArtist`) and their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) is coincidental to their distinct test-fixture roles. Merging or genericising them would couple unrelated test suites across package boundaries without production benefit.
